Full-time Dental Technician position available in Randwick 2031

Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Position based in Randwick NSW2031
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.
•	Salary to be offered: $79,500 to $85,000 (exclusive of superannuation)

Position Overview
Sydney Smile Specialists is a leading dental clinic committed to delivering exceptional dental care, with a strong focus on precision, innovation and patient comfort. Its team comprises highly skilled professionals dedicated to providing high-quality services and ensuring each patient receives personalised and professional care.

On behalf of Sydney Smile Specialists, we are seeking an experienced and skilled Dental Technician to join its team. The Dental Technician will be responsible for producing dental models and appliances, including bleaching trays, orthodontic retainers, custom impression trays, provisional veneer templates and occlusal splints, while maintaining strict infection control, sterilisation and quality standards.

Position Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Receive, disinfect and prepare dental impressions in accordance with infection-control procedures.
•	Pour, trim, articulate and mount dental models for the construction of dental appliances and restorations.
•	Use thermoforming equipment to produce bleaching trays, orthodontic retainers, custom impression trays, provisional veneer templates and occlusal splints.
•	Construct screw-retained immediate implant crowns in accordance with dentists’ prescriptions and technical specifications.
•	Select and prepare suitable materials for the construction, finishing and polishing of dental appliances.
•	Inspect, adjust and repair dental models, crowns and appliances to ensure accuracy and quality.
•	Disinfect completed dental work and maintain laboratory instruments, equipment and work areas.
•	Maintain laboratory records and quality-control documentation.
•	Keep up to date with developments in dental laboratory materials, techniques and equipment.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification in Dentistry or Dental Technology.
•	At least 1 year of relevant experience in a similar role.
•	Excellent manual dexterity, precision and attention to detail.
•	Ability to interpret dentists’ prescriptions, impressions and dental specifications.
•	Strong quality-control skills to ensure completed work meets required accuracy, functionality and presentation standards. 

Salary: This is a full-time position with competitive remuneration between $79,500 to $85,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

About TAG

TAG is a Melbourne-based full-service digital marketing agency partnering with businesses to drive growth through strategy, creative, paid media, websites, CRM and digital transformation. Our head office is located in Balaclava, Melbourne, where this full-time position is based.

We're seeking a talented Multimedia Designer to create engaging digital content across multiple platforms, helping our clients communicate effectively and achieve meaningful commercial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

*Consult with clients and internal teams to determine creative objectives, audience requirements and project outcomes.
*Design and produce multimedia content including digital graphics, motion graphics, animations, video assets and interactive content.
*Develop creative concepts and visual solutions for digital campaigns, websites, social media and marketing initiatives.
*Create static and animated assets using industry-standard design and multimedia software.
*Collaborate with strategists, designers, developers and marketing specialists to deliver integrated creative solutions.
*Prepare production-ready artwork and oversee quality throughout the production process.
*Ensure all creative work aligns with client brand guidelines, technical specifications and campaign objectives.
*Contribute innovative ideas that improve user engagement, creative quality and campaign performance.
*Stay current with emerging multimedia technologies, creative trends and industry best practices.

Skills & Experience

*Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Digital Media or a related discipline.
*Demonstrated experience producing multimedia content with a strong digital portfolio.
*Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects, Illustrator and Photoshop.
*Experience creating digital assets across websites, social media and online marketing campaigns.
*Strong creative, visual communication and problem-solving skills.
*Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.

result.description:
On behalf of our client Gulf Hydraulic, we are seeking a qualified Fitter General, fitter and turners /Machinists for a full-time position in Malaga. Gulf Hydraulics Australia is a leader in the Hydraulics Industry for the service and repair of Hydraulic Pumps, Motors and Cylinders and has been recognised as service provider for the offshore, industrial and mining sectors.

Primary responsibilities Fitters and Turners
 
- Assembled and fitted precision hydraulic cylinder components, including barrels, rods, pistons, glands, and specialized seal kits, to full operational compliance.
- Operated workshop machinery and heavy press equipment to accurately install interference-fit bushes and components.
- Conducted diagnostic pressure testing, including bypass and static pressure leak testing, to verify fluid power integrity and safety standards.
- Utilized precision hand tools and torque equipment to tighten fasteners and sub-assemblies to exact OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications.
- Maintained quality control records, documented test data, and assigned unique job identifiers/ID tracking to completed units prior to final surface finishing (coating/spraying).
- Setting up and operating conventional lathes and milling machines to turn, face, thread, or bore metal stock.
- Machining new or worn parts (like reclaiming a worn cylinder rod or machining a new gland/piston from scratch) to exact tolerances.
- Using engineering drawings and precision measuring tools (micrometers, vernier calipers) to machine components down to the millimeter.

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminum, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Adequate work experience or Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina


The salary range is from $79,500 to $85,000 per year plus super.
